profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at ISS | Institutional Shareholder Services

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Data Science and AI Engineering group.  Driving forward AI innovation in FinTech and promoting AI developer enablement; removing legacy barriers while ensuring compliance and responsible SDLC.  Fine tuning embedding and generation models for RAG, on-prem hardware scaling, frontier models. Metrics and agentic RAG evaluation (DeepEval etc).

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Risk modeling, fixed income and derivatives Monte Carlo / parametric engines. Distributed risk model orchestration services / liquidity modeling.  Full stack SDLC , cloud CI/CD.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer in multiple departments. Specialized in high performance microservices and system architecture.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Oracle Database · Microsoft SQL Server · Java · Perl · C# · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: Queens, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description: Worked as the web developer client website implementations using full spectrum of web technologies. Responsibilities included assisting sales and project planning (consulting on technical aspects of client proposals), designing database schemas, implementing all aspects of website design, connecting e-commerce/merchant platforms (cybercash).
positions.insights: Skills: User Experience (UX) · E-Commerce · CGI/Perl · Credit Card Transaction Processing · PostgreSQL
